project_id.description: SESSION PROJECT: References projects._id; existence must be checked by the application.

agent_model.description: AGENT MODEL: Model name stored directly rather than an agent reference.

started_at.description: STARTED AT: Required BSON date supplied by the application.

ended_at.description: ENDED AT: BSON date when the session ends, or null while running.

branch.description: BRANCH: Git branch associated with the session.

status.description: STATUS: Session status; allowed values are managed by the application.

shell.description: SHELL: Shell used to run the session.
